build_imnormalize: build a python module to normalize an image array with given mean and std values
build_adjust_brightness: build a python module to adjust the brightness of an image by a given factor
build_adjust_contrast: build a python module to adjust the contrast of an image by a given factor
build_auto_contrast: build a python module to auto adjust image contrast by removing cutoff percent of histogram
build_adjust_hue: build a python module to adjust the hue of an image by shifting the HSV hue channel
